about: Each person holds the same role in Twenty and in uVENTURE, matched on their KUEC email. One row per Twenty role a person can hold; the uVENTURE administrator confirms the uVENTURE role names and rights before the pilot. Rules and the joiner and leaver procedure: kuec/runbooks/21-uventure-readiness.md section 2. kuec/app/src/roles/uventure-role-map.test.ts fails when a Twenty role is missing here.
joinKey: KUEC work email, lower case, identical in Entra ID, Twenty and uVENTURE

roles.uventureRights: Reads everything; approves licences and agreements; no system settings.
Reads everything; triages new challenges and sign-ups; no system settings.
Reads technologies, equipment, labs and challenges; records the hand-offs the playbooks name; edits nothing it does not own.
Owns technologies and their marketing status; records licences and option agreements.
Owns invention disclosures and patents; reads technologies and licences.
Owns space listings and leasing agreements; reads the rest.
Owns lab and equipment listings and their availability; reads the rest.
Owns startup and subsidiary records; reads technologies and licences.
Reads records to support the integration; no business edits in production.
Reads dashboards and portfolio summaries only.

serviceAccounts.usedBy: uVENTURE's nightly read of Twenty, through the API key uventure-reader-<env>-<yyyy-mm>
Twenty-side scripts and integrations; no uVENTURE account
